title: Bitwise XOR of All Pairings
description: You are given two 0-indexed arrays of non-negative integers `nums1` and `nums2`. Consider the array formed by taking `nums1[i] XOR nums2[j]` for every valid pair of indices `(i, j)`. Return the bitwise XOR of all integers in this pairing array.
hints: Each element of `nums1` participates in `nums2.length` pairings, and each element of `nums2` participates in `nums1.length` pairings.
Any number XORed with itself an even number of times becomes 0, so an array contributes its total XOR only when the other array has odd length.

examples.explanation: nums1 has length 3 (odd) and nums2 has length 4 (even), so only nums2 contributes: 10^2^5^0 = 13.
Both arrays have even length 2, so every value cancels out and the total XOR is 0.
